digest.component_or_area: automated quality audit and enforcement gates
propositions: Approved maintainability and reliability ratchets must be enforced without regressing existing diagnostic coverage across function complexity (C901), Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores), Ruff rule families (ASYNC, DTZ, RUF), and related quality gates.

Four interdependent child stories must be delivered in strict dependency order (d9f5 → 28cd → 125d) with shared pyproject.toml ownership and a common Ruff ratchet test file (tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py) created by 28cd and extended by 125d.

Every newly-enforced gate (make lint, make typecheck, config-check, C901 --check, Ruff rule families) must exit 0 against the current origin/main tip before being landed, and all pre-existing ratchet-family diagnostics on origin/main must be resolved or captured in baselines.

All direct child stories and integration test tiers (unit pytest and integration pytest) must pass before the epic is closed, with independently attestable Gerrit labels (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1) and zero unresolved comments on every merged change.
